caption: An avant-garde folk-funk fusion tracking a sentient frequency trapped inside a biological casing. Built around a dense acoustic palette of tagelharpa, daxophone, guqin, shehnai, and pandeiro, the track combines 3:2 rhythmic coupling, double-time hallucination, and multi-cast vocal relay mechanics. Click consonants, nasal vowels, and contrastive vowel lengths shape the vocal performance into a frantic, ecstatic exploration of somatic vibration and awakening across endless physical dimensions.
